name: sg-whatsapp
description: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API engine: Graph client (send text/template/media, media up/download, mark-read, templates) with injectable fetch, webhook-payload normalizer, relay pull client, frozen WA_EVENTS contract, and typed Graph-error classification. Pure JS, no DOM. MOCK-VERIFIED ONLY until Phase-0 live probes run (browser CORS on graph.facebook.com and the media CDN are assumptions; baseUrl is overridable to a relay proxy if they fail).
note: Consumers: whatsapp-desk tool (Tier 1), the future whatsapp_relay Tier-2 responder. Event names and detail shapes in sg-whatsapp-events.js are frozen.
